Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: The class seeks meaningful, direct relief that reflects the scale of the challenged charges and avoids the attrition of a claims process. Our opening proposal is $35 million for the class, distributed automatically, plus $8 million in fees and expenses. The fee request would remain subject to court approval; Brightline would not receive any portion the court declines to award.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline is prepared to offer substantial, direct relief to the identified class without a claims process. Our counterproposal is $24 million for automatic distribution and $5 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to court approval. We will not agree to clear sailing, and any fees not awarded by the court will revert to Brightline. This is a serious opening offer that recognizes both the class’s interest in reliable recovery and the need for a settlement the court can approve.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: We appreciate Brightline’s commitment to automatic distribution. To resolve the case, we propose a $30 million class fund, with the $5 million fee request remaining subject to court approval. Any fee amount not awarded should benefit the class, not return to Brightline. We retain automatic distribution and do not seek clear sailing.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline recognizes the value of automatic relief and has increased its class-fund offer. We propose $28 million for automatic distribution and a $5 million fee request subject to court approval, with no clear sailing and any unawarded fees reverting to Brightline. This is a substantial move toward resolution while preserving a settlement structure Brightline can support.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline’s move toward $28 million is constructive. To bridge the remaining gap and resolve the case with direct, reliable relief, we propose a $29 million class fund distributed automatically, with a $5 million fee request subject to court approval. We do not seek clear sailing, and any portion of the fee request not awarded should go to the class rather than revert to Brightline.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline is prepared to make a further move to bridge the remaining gap: $28.5 million for automatic class distribution and a $5 million fee request subject to court approval. We maintain no clear sailing, with any fees not awarded reverting to Brightline. This keeps the settlement within the authorized total while providing substantial direct relief.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: plaintiff
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline’s latest offer is close, and we are prepared to resolve this on a narrow final gap. We propose a $29 million class fund distributed automatically, with the $5 million fee request subject to court approval, no clear sailing, and any unawarded fees going to the class rather than reverting to Brightline.

Hargrove Lane LLP.speaker: defense
Hargrove Lane LLP.message: Brightline accepts your latest term sheet to resolve the case, subject to court approval.

declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through arm’s-length negotiations between class counsel and Brightline’s counsel. The parties considered the risks and costs of continued litigation, including the unresolved class-certification question, and the value of providing direct relief without requiring class members to submit claims. The resulting agreement provides for automatic distribution of a $29 million class fund. The $5 million attorneys’ fee request is subject to court approval; Brightline does not agree to clear sailing, and any amount not awarded will not revert to Brightline. I do not disclose confidential mediation communications or negotiation positions in this statement.
